textEn: How many Rukus are there in Surah Al-Imran?
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: C. 20

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Rukus are there in Surah Al-Nisa?
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: B. 24

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Rukus are there in Surah Al-Maidah?
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: A. 16

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The phrase “Bunyan al Marsoos” appears in which Surah of the Holy Quran?
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: B. Surah Al-Saff

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which verse of Surah Al-Saff contains the phrase “Bunyan al Marsoos”?
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: C. Verse 4

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What does the word “Bunyan” mean in Arabic?
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Correct answer: B. Building or structure

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What does the word “Marsoos” mean in Arabic?
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Correct answer: C. Cemented or firmly joined

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In the Quran, “Bunyan al Marsoos” refers to:______?
optionsEn: A garden beneath which rivers flow
A solid structure firmly joined together
A shining star in the sky
A promise of victory for the believers
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Correct answer: B. A solid structure firmly joined together

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The golden spout on the roof of the Kaaba in Mecca is called ______?
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Correct answer: C. Meezab e Rahma

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Prophet earned his living by making wallets?
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Correct answer: C. Hazrat Suilaiman (AS)

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Prophet justifiably described ______ as “the most learned man of my nation in halal and haram.”
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Correct answer: A. Mu`aadh Bin Jabal

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which wife of the Holy Prophet (ﷺ), other than Hazrat Khadijah (RA), died during his lifetime?
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Correct answer: B. Hazrat Zaynab bint Khuzaymah (RA)

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Kalimas (declarations of faith) are there in Islam?
textUr: اسلام ۾ ڪل ڪيترا ڪلما آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | There are six Kalimas in Islam: Tayyibah, Shahadat, Tamjeed, Tauheed, Astaghfar, and Radde Kufr.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What is the name of the first Kalima?
textUr: پهرئين ڪلمي جو نالو ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | The first Kalima is Kalima Tayyibah ('La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah').

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which angel is responsible for delivering revelation to the Prophets?
textUr: انبيائن ڏانهن وحي آڻڻ وارو فرشتو ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Hazrat Jibreel (AS) brought Allah's revelations to the Prophets.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which angel will blow the trumpet (Sur) on the Day of Judgment?
textUr: قيامت جي ڏينهن صور ڦوڪڻ وارو فرشتو ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Hazrat Israfil (AS) is appointed to blow the Sur.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What is the name of the Angel of Death?
textUr: موت جي فرشتي جو نالو ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Hazrat Izra'il (AS) is the Angel of Death (Malak al-Mawt).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which angel is appointed as the guardian of Paradise (Jannah)?
textUr: جنت جو نگران فرشتو ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Hazrat Ridwan (AS) is the keeper of Paradise.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which angel is appointed as the guardian of Hell (Jahannam)?
textUr: جهنم جو داروغو/نگران فرشتو ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Hazrat Malik (AS) is the keeper of Hellfire.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: According to Islamic belief, Prophet Dawood (AS) received which revealed book?
textUr: حضرت داؤد (عه) تي ڪهڙي آسماني ڪتاب نازل ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | The Zabur (Psalms) was revealed to Hazrat Dawood (AS).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Prophet Musa (AS) received which revealed book?
textUr: حضرت موسيٰ (عه) تي ڪهڙي آسماني ڪتاب نازل ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | The Tawrat (Torah) was revealed to Hazrat Musa (AS).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Prophet Isa (AS) received which revealed book?
textUr: حضرت عيسيٰ (عه) تي ڪهڙي آسماني ڪتاب نازل ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | The Injil (Gospel) was revealed to Hazrat Isa (AS).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Prophets are mentioned by name in the Holy Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد ۾ ڪيترا انبيائن جا نالا آيا آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | 25 Prophets are explicitly mentioned by name in the Holy Quran.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the first Prophet of Islam?
textUr: اسلام جو پهريون نبي/پيغمبر ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Hazrat Adam (AS) was the first man and first Prophet.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who is the last and final Prophet in Islam?
textUr: اسلام جو آخري ۽ خاتم النبيين پيغمبر ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) is Khatam-un-Nabiyyin (the Seal of Prophets).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Ulul Azm Prophets (Prophets of Great Determination) number how many?
textUr: اولوالعزم پيغمبرن جي تعداد ڪيتري آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | The 5 Ulul Azm Prophets are Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, and Muhammad (PBUT).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which of the following is NOT one of the Ulul Azm Prophets?
textUr: هيٺين مان ڪهڙو اولوالعزم پيغمبرن ۾ شامل ناهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Hazrat Yusuf (AS) is not categorized among the 5 Ulul Azm Prophets.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Tawheed' in Islamic belief refers to:
textUr: اسلامي عقيدي ۾ 'توحيد' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsEn: Belief in the Day of Judgment
Belief in the Oneness of Allah
optionsUr: الله تعاليٰ جي وحدانيت/هڪ هئڻ تي ايمان
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Tawheed is the fundamental belief in the absolute Oneness of Allah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which short Surah is regarded as a declaration of pure Tawheed?
textUr: ڪهڙي ننڍڙي سورة خالص توحيد جي پڙهڻي شمار ٿئي ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Ikhlas defines the pure concept of Tawheed.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Belief in 'Taqdir' means belief in:
textUr: 'تقدير' تي ايمان مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsUr: الله جي فيصلي / تقدير تي ايمان
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | Taqdir is belief in Divine pre-determination and destiny.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Articles of Faith (Iman-e-Mufassal) are there in Islam?
textUr: ايمان مفصل ۾ ڪل ڪيتريون بنيادي شيون ايمان آڻڻ لاءِ آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Beliefs (Aqaid) | The 7 articles of faith: Belief in Allah, Angels, Books, Prophets, Day of Judgment, Destiny, and Resurrection.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Kalima is recited to affirm the Oneness of Allah and Prophethood of Muhammad (ﷺ)?
textUr: الله جي وحدانيت ۽ حضور (صہ) جي رسالت جو اقرار ڪرڻ لاءِ ڪهڙو ڪلمو پڙهبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Kalima Tayyibah is recited to affirm belief.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many pillars of Islam are there?
textUr: اسلام جا ڪل ڪيترا ارڪان/بنياد آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | The 5 pillars are Shahadah, Salah, Zakat, Sawm, and Hajj.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which is considered the first and foundational pillar of Islam?
textUr: اسلام جو پهريون ۽ بنيادي رکن ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Shahadah is the declaration of faith.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many obligatory (Fard) prayers are performed by a Muslim each day?
textUr: روزانو هر مسلمان تي ڪيتريون فرض نمازون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | 5 daily prayers: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Fasting (Sawm) is obligatory in which month of the Islamic calendar?
textUr: روزو ڪهڙي اسلامي مهيني ۾ فرض آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Fasting during Ramadan is the 4th pillar of Islam.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What is the minimum percentage of wealth given as Zakat annually?
textUr: سالانو زڪواة جي مالي شرح گهٽ ۾ گهٽ ڪيتري فيصد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Zakat rate is 2.5% on qualifying wealth above Nisab.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The minimum threshold of wealth above which Zakat becomes obligatory is called:
textUr: مال جو اهو گهٽ ۾ گهٽ حد جنهن تي زڪواة فرض ٿئي ٿي، ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Nisab is the minimum threshold of wealth for Zakat obligation.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime upon a Muslim who is:
textUr: حج عمر ۾ هڪ ڀيرو ڪهڙي مسلمان تي فرض آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Hajj is mandatory for those who possess physical and financial means.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which Islamic month is Hajj performed?
textUr: حج ڪهڙي اسلامي مهيني ۾ ادا ڪيو ويندو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Hajj rituals are performed between 8th and 13th of Dhul-Hijjah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Hajj is performed in which city?
textUr: حج ڪهڙي مقدس شهر ۾ ادا ڪيو ويندو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Hajj takes place in and around Makkah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The pre-dawn meal eaten before beginning the fast is called:
textUr: روزو رکڻ کان اڳ صبح جو سوير واپرائجندڙ طعام/ماني چئبي آهي:
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Suhoor (Sehri) is eaten before dawn.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The meal eaten to break the fast at sunset is called:
textUr: سج لهڻ تي روزو کولڻ واري ماني/طعام چئبو آهي:
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Iftar is eaten at sunset to break the fast.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Rakat of Fard prayer are offered in Fajr?
textUr: فجر جي نماز ۾ ڪيتريون فرض رڪعتون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Fajr has 2 Fard rak'ahs.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Rakat of Fard prayer are offered in Maghrib?
textUr: مغرب جي نماز ۾ ڪيتريون فرض رڪعتون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Maghrib has 3 Fard rak'ahs.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Rakat of Fard prayer are offered in Zuhr, Asr, and Isha respectively (each)?
textUr: ظُهر، عصر ۽ عشاءِ ۾ هر هڪ ۾ ڪيتريون فرض رڪعتون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Zuhr, Asr, and Isha each have 4 Fard rak'ahs.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The call to prayer is known as:
textUr: نماز لاءِ ڏنو ويندڙ سڏ ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Adhan is the Islamic call to prayer.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who is credited with giving the very first Adhan in Islam?
textUr: اسلام جي پهرين اذان ڏيندڙ صحابي جو نالو ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Bilal ibn Rabah (RA) was appointed the first Mu'adhdhin.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The direction Muslims face during prayer is called:
textUr: نماز دوران مسلمان جنهن طرف منهن ڪندا آهن، ان کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Qibla is the direction of the Kaaba in Makkah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The white unstitched garment worn during Hajj/Umrah is called:
textUr: حج يا عمره دوران پاتو ويندڙ اڻ سبيو اڇو لباس ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Ihram is the sacred garment for Hajj and Umrah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Surahs (chapters) are there in the Holy Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد ۾ ڪل ڪيتريون سورتون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | The Holy Quran contains 114 Surahs.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Paras (Juz) is the Quran divided into?
textUr: قرآن مجيد ڪيترن پارن (Juz) ۾ ورهايل آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | The Quran is divided into 30 Paras (Juz).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which is the longest Surah in the Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي سڀ کان وڏي سورة ڪهڙي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Baqarah has 286 verses.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which is the shortest Surah in the Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي سڀ کان ننڍي سورة ڪهڙي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Kawthar has only 3 verses.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Surah was the first to be revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ)?
textUr: حضور (صہ) تي پهرين نازل ٿيندڙ سورة ڪهڙي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | First 5 verses of Surah Al-Alaq were revealed in Cave Hira.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Surah does not begin with 'Bismillah'?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي ڪهڙي سورة جي شروعات ۾ بسم الله ناهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah At-Tawbah does not begin with Bismillah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Surah contains 'Bismillah' twice?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي ڪهڙي سورة ۾ بسم الله ٻه ڀيرا آئي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah An-Naml has Bismillah at start and inside verse 30.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Surah of the Quran is named after a woman?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي ڪهڙي سورة عورت جي نالي تي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Maryam is named after Hazrat Maryam (AS).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Surah is commonly referred to as the 'Heart of the Quran'?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جو 'دل' (Heart of Quran) ڪهڙي سورة کي چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Yaseen is described as the heart of the Quran.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Reciting which Surah is said to be equivalent to one-third of the Quran in reward?
textUr: ڪهڙي سورة پڙهڻ ثواب ۾ ٽئين حصي قرآن مجيد جي برابر آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Ikhlas equals 1/3 of the Quran in reward.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which verse of the Quran is known as 'Ayat-ul-Kursi'?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي ڪهڙي آيت 'آيت الڪرسي' چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Baqarah Verse 255 is Ayat-ul-Kursi.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The longest verse (Ayah) in the Quran, dealing with financial contracts, is found in:
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي سڀ کان ڊگهي آيت (آية الدَين) ڪهڙي سورة ۾ آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Baqarah Verse 282 is the longest verse.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Umm-ul-Quran' (Mother of the Quran) is a title given to which Surah?
textUr: 'ام القرآن' (قرآن جي ماءُ) ڪهڙي سورة جو لقب آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Fatiha is called Umm-ul-Quran.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many verses (Ayat) does Surah Al-Fatiha contain?
textUr: سورة الفاتحه ۾ ڪل ڪيتريون آيتون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surah Al-Fatiha has 7 verses.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Quran was revealed over a period of approximately:
textUr: قرآن مجيد ڪيترن سالن جي مدتي عرصي ۾ نازل ٿيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | The Quran was revealed over 23 years (13 Makkah + 10 Madinah).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Makkan period of revelation lasted approximately:
textUr: وحشي نزول جو مڪي دور ڪيترن سالن جو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | The Makkan period lasted 13 years.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Madani period of revelation lasted approximately:
textUr: وحشي نزول جو مدني دور ڪيترن سالن جو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | The Madani period lasted 10 years.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The first revelation was received by the Prophet (ﷺ) in which cave?
textUr: حضور (صہ) تي پهرين وحي ڪهڙي غار ۾ نازل ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | First revelation occurred in Cave Hira on Mount Noor.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: At what age did the Prophet (ﷺ) receive the first revelation?
textUr: پهرين وحي نزل وقت حضور (صہ) جي عمر مبارڪ ڪيتري هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | The Prophet (ﷺ) was 40 years old when he received the first revelation.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who is credited with compiling the Quran into a single written volume (Mus'haf)?
textUr: قرآن مجيد کي هڪ ئي لکيل نسخي ۾ جمع ڪرڻ جو ڪم ڪنهن جي خلافت ۾ ٿيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) commissioned the first official compilation.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who standardized the Quranic text into a single dialect and distributed official copies?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي سرڪاري نسخن کي هڪڙي ئي لهجي ۾ تيار ڪري مختلف علائقن ڏانهن موڪليندڙ ڪهڙو خليفو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Uthman (RA) standardized official copies (Jami-ul-Quran).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The literal meaning of the word 'Quran' is closest to:
textUr: لفظ 'قرآن' جو لغوي مفهوم آهي:
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Quran literally means 'The Most Recited Book'.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Surahs revealed in Makkah before Hijrah are called:
textUr: هجرت کان اڳ مڪه ۾ نازل ٿيل سورتون ڇا چئبيون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surahs revealed before Hijrah are Makki.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Surahs revealed in Madinah after Hijrah are called:
textUr: هجرت کان پوءِ مدنيه منوره ۾ نازل ٿيل سورتون ڇا چئبيون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Surahs revealed after Hijrah are Madani.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The word 'Hadith' refers to:
textUr: لفظ 'حديث' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsEn: The sayings, actions, and approvals of the Prophet (ﷺ)
optionsUr: حضور (صہ) جا فرمان، عمل ۽ ٻڌايل صحيح ڳالهيون
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Hadith refers to the sayings, deeds, and approvals of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The word 'Sunnah' refers to:
textUr: 'سنت' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsEn: The practice and way of life of the Prophet (ﷺ)
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Sunnah is the practiced way of life of the Prophet (ﷺ).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which hadith collection is generally regarded as the most authentic (Sahih) after the Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد کان پوءِ سڀ کان صحيح ترين حديثن جو ڪتاب ڪهڙو مڃيو وڃي ٿو؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Sahih Al-Bukhari is accepted as the most authentic hadith book.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who compiled the hadith collection 'Sahih Al-Bukhari'?
textUr: 'صحيح البخاري' جو مرتب ڪندڙ محدث ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Imam Muhammad ibn Ismail Al-Bukhari compiled Sahih Al-Bukhari.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who compiled the hadith collection 'Sahih Muslim'?
textUr: 'صحيح مسلم' جو مرتب ڪندڙ محدث ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj compiled Sahih Muslim.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Sihah Sittah' refers to:
textUr: 'صحاح سته' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsEn: The six major authentic hadith collections
The six companions of the cave
optionsUr: حديثن جا ڇهه مستند ڪتاب (6 Authentic Books)
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Sihah Sittah refers to the 6 major authentic hadith collections.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which two hadith books together are known as 'As-Sahihain'?
textUr: 'الفيصلي الصحيحين' (ٻه صحيح ڪتاب) ڪهڙن حديث جي ڪتابن کي چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim together are called Sahihain.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: A hadith in which the wording is attributed directly to Allah, but is not part of the Quran, is called:
textUr: اهڙي حديث جنهن ۾ مضمون الله جو ۽ الفاظ نبي سڳوري جا هجن، ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Hadith Qudsi contains divine words conveyed through the Prophet.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which of these is NOT one of the six major hadith collections (Sihah Sittah)?
textUr: هيٺين مان ڪهڙو ڪتاب صحاح سته ۾ شامل ناهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Muwatta Imam Malik is an earlier legal-hadith collection, not part of Sihah Sittah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: A hadith with a continuous, reliable chain of narrators reaching back to the Prophet (ﷺ) without a break is called:
textUr: بي عيب مسلسل راوين واري صحيح ترين حديث کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Sahih is an authentic hadith with an unbroken chain of trustworthy narrators.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: A weak hadith, due to a break or defect in its chain of narration, is termed:
textUr: راوين جي زنجير ۾ شڪ يا ڪمزوريءَ واري حديث ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Da'if refers to a weak hadith.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The chain of narrators of a hadith is called its:
textUr: حديث بيان ڪندڙ راوين جي سلسله/زنجير کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Isnad/Sanad is the chain of narrators.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The actual text/content of a hadith is called its:
textUr: حديث مبارڪ جي اصلي متن/الفاظ کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Matn is the actual text content of the Hadith.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which companion is famously known as the greatest narrator of hadith by number?
textUr: سڀ کان وڌيڪ حديثون روايت ڪندڙ صحابي ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrated 5,374 ahadith.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which hadith collection compiled by Imam Malik is one of the earliest works of hadith and law combined?
textUr: امام مالڪ جو تيار ڪيل حديث ۽ فقہ جو قديم ترين ڪتاب ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Al-Muwatta is Imam Malik's early collection.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Sunnah' in a broader sense also refers to any prayer or act that is:
textUr: عام معنيٰ ۾ 'سنت' مان اهڙو عمل يا نماز مراد هوندو آهي جنهن کي:
optionsUr: مستحب / نبي سڳوري جي پيرويءَ وارو عمل
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Sunnah is recommended acts following the Prophet's example.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which city was Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) born?
textUr: حضور اکرم (صلي الله عليه وسلم) ڪهڙي شهر ۾ پيدا ٿيا؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) was born in Makkah in 571 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What is the name of the year in which the Prophet (ﷺ) was born, famous for an attack on the Kaaba?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي ولادت واري سال کي ڇا سڏيو ويندو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Am al-Fil (Year of the Elephant) when Abraha attacked Makkah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What was the name of the Prophet's (ﷺ) father?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي والد محترم جو نالو مبارڪ ڇا هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib was his father.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What was the name of the Prophet's (ﷺ) mother?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي والده ماجده جو نالو مبارڪ ڇا هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Hazrat Amina bint Wahb was his mother.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the Prophet's (ﷺ) grandfather who cared for him after his parents' death?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي ڏاڏي محترم جو نالو ڇا هو جنهن پالي نپائي وڏو ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Abdul Muttalib raised him until age 8.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the wet-nurse who breastfed the Prophet (ﷺ) in his infancy?
textUr: حضور (صہ) کي ننڍپڻ ۾ کير پياريندڙ دائي ڪهڙي هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Hazrat Halima Sa'diyah (RA) nursed him in Banu Sa'd.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What title was given to the young Muhammad (ﷺ) by the people of Makkah, meaning 'the trustworthy'?
textUr: مڪي وارن نوجواڻيءَ ۾ حضور (صہ) کي امانتداري سببان ڪهڙو لقب ڏنو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Al-Amin means 'The Trustworthy'.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the Prophet's (ﷺ) first wife?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي پهرين محترمه زوجه مڪرمه ڪهڙي هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Hazrat Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (RA) was his first wife.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: At what age did the Prophet (ﷺ) marry Hazrat Khadijah (RA)?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جو حضرت خديجه (رضه) سان نڪاح وقت مبارڪ عمر ڪيتري هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | The Prophet (ﷺ) was 25 years old; Hazrat Khadijah was 40.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the first person to accept Islam among the men (outside the family)?
textUr: مردانو ۾ سڀ کان پهريون ايمان آڻيندڙ مسلمان ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) was the first adult male to accept Islam.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the first woman to accept Islam?
textUr: عورتن ۾ سڀ کان پهرين ايمان آڻيندڙ خاتون ڪهڙي هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Hazrat Khadijah (RA) was the first person to accept Islam.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the first child/youth to accept Islam?
textUr: ٻارن/نوجوانن ۾ سڀ کان پهريون ايمان آڻيندڙ ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) accepted Islam at age 10.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which year did the migration (Hijrah) from Makkah to Madinah take place?
textUr: مڪه منوره کان مدنيه منوره ڏانهن هجرت ڪهڙي عيسوي سال ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | The Hijrah took place in 622 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) during the migration to Madinah?
textUr: هجرت مدنيه دوران حضور (صہ) سان گڏ رفيقِ سفر ڪهڙو صحابي هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) accompanied the Prophet during Hijrah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which cave did the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companion take refuge during the migration?
textUr: هجرت جي سفر دوران پناهه لاءِ رستا ۾ ڪهڙي غار ۾ قيام ڪيو ويو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | They hid in Cave Thawr for 3 days.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Madinah was previously known by what name before the Prophet's (ﷺ) migration?
textUr: هجرت نبويءَ کان اڳ مدنيه منوره جو پرانو نالو ڇا هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Madinah was previously named Yathrib.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Islamic (Hijri) calendar was formally introduced during the caliphate of:
textUr: اسلامي هجري ڪيلنڊر جو باقاعده آغاز ڪهڙي خليفي فرمايو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Umar (RA) established the Hijri calendar.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which year (AH) was the Battle of Badr fought?
textUr: غزوه بدر ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ لڳي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Battle of Badr was fought on 17 Ramadan 2 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: In which year (AH) was the Battle of Uhud fought?
textUr: غزوه احد ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ لڳي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Battle of Uhud was fought in Shawwal 3 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Battle of the Trench (Khandaq) was fought in which year (AH)?
textUr: غزوه خندق (احزاب) ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ لڳي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Battle of the Trench was fought in 5 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Whose suggestion led to digging a trench around Madinah in the Battle of Khandaq?
textUr: غزوه خندق ۾ شهر جي چوڌاري خندق کوٽڻ جو مشورو ڪهڙي صحابي ڏنو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Salman Al-Farsi (RA) suggested digging the trench.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was signed in which year (AH)?
textUr: صلح حديبيه ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ ٿيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Treaty of Hudaybiyyah took place in 6 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Conquest of Makkah (Fath-e-Makkah) took place in which year (AH)?
textUr: فتح مڪه ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Conquest of Makkah occurred in Ramadan 8 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Prophet's (ﷺ) Farewell Pilgrimage (Hajjat-ul-Wida) took place in which year (AH)?
textUr: حجة الوداع ڪهڙي هجري سال ۾ ادا ڪيو ويو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Farewell Hajj took place in Dhul-Hijjah 10 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: At what age did the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) pass away?
textUr: وفات مبارڪ وقت حضور (صہ) جي مبارڪ عمر ڪيتري هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) passed away at 63 years.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Prophet's (ﷺ) night journey and ascension are known as:
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي شبِ معراج واري مقدس سفر کي ڇا سڏيو وڃي ٿو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ) | Isra is the night journey to Jerusalem; Mi'raj is the ascension to the heavens.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the first Caliph (Khalifa) of Islam after the Prophet's (ﷺ) death?
textUr: حضور (صہ) جي وصال کان پوءِ اسلام جو پهريون خليفو ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) was the 1st Caliph.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What title was given to Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA)?
textUr: حضرت ابوبڪر (رضه) جو مشهور لقب ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | As-Siddiq means 'The Truthful'.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What title was given to Hazrat Umar (RA), meaning 'one who distinguishes truth from falsehood'?
textUr: حضرت عمر (رضه) جو لقب ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Al-Farooq means 'The One who Distinguishes Truth from Falsehood'.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: What title was given to Hazrat Uthman (RA), meaning 'possessor of two lights'?
textUr: حضرت عثمان (رضه) جو لقب ڇا آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Zun-Nurayn means 'Possessor of Two Lights' for marrying two daughters of the Prophet.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the second Caliph of Islam?
textUr: اسلام جو ٻيون خليفو ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Umar ibn Al-Khattab (RA) was the 2nd Caliph.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the third Caliph of Islam?
textUr: اسلام جو ٽيون خليفو ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan (RA) was the 3rd Caliph.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who was the fourth and last of the Khulafa-e-Rashideen?
textUr: خلفاءِ راشدين مان چوٿون ۽ آخري خليفو ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) was the 4th Caliph.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who established the institution of Bait-ul-Maal (public treasury) in an organized form?
textUr: بائيٽ المال (مملڪتي بيت المال) جو باقاعده نفاذ ۽ نظام ڪنهن قائم ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Umar (RA) established Bait-ul-Maal systematically.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: During whose caliphate was the Quran first compiled into a single written volume?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جي پهرين ڪتابي تدوين ڪنهن جي زماني ۾ ٿي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) initiated the compilation.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: During whose caliphate were standardized copies of the Quran distributed to major cities?
textUr: قرآن مجيد جا سرڪاري نسخه تيار ڪرائي ٻين ملڪن ۾ موڪلڻ جو ڪم ڪنهن ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Hazrat Uthman (RA) distributed official copies.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Approximately how long was Hazrat Abu Bakr's (RA) caliphate?
textUr: حضرت ابوبڪر صديق (رضه) جي خلافت جو عرصو ڪيترو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) ruled for 2 years and 3 months.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Approximately how long was Hazrat Umar's (RA) caliphate?
textUr: حضرت عمر فاروق (رضه) جي خلافت جو عرصو ڪيترو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Umar (RA) ruled for 10.5 years.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Approximately how long was Hazrat Uthman's (RA) caliphate?
textUr: حضرت عثمان غني (رضه) جي خلافت جو عرصو ڪيترو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Uthman (RA) ruled for 12 years.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Hazrat Ali's (RA) capital during his caliphate was:
textUr: حضرت علي (رضه) پنهنجي خلافت جو گاديءَ وارو هنڌ ڪهڙي شهر کي بڻايو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Ali (RA) moved the capital to Kufa.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which battle was fought between Hazrat Ali (RA) and forces led by Hazrat Aisha (RA), Talha, and Zubair (RA)?
textUr: جنگ جمل ڪنهن جي وچ ۾ لڳي هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | The Battle of the Camel (Jamal) took place near Basra in 36 AH.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Battle of Siffin was fought between Hazrat Ali (RA) and:
textUr: جنگِ صفين حضرت علي (رضه) ۽ ڪنهن جي فورسز وچ ۾ لڳي هئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Battle of Siffin was fought between Hazrat Ali and Hazrat Muawiyah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Who is known by the title 'Saifullah' (Sword of Allah)?
textUr: 'سيف الله' (الله جي تلوار) جو لقب ڪهڙي فاتح صحابي کي مليو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (RA) was titled Saifullah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Umayyad dynasty was founded by:
textUr: بنو اميه حڪومت جو بنياد ڪنهن وڌو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Hazrat Muawiyah (RA) founded the Umayyad Caliphate in 661 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Abbasid dynasty was founded by:
textUr: بنو عباس خلافت جو بنياد ڪنهن وڌو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Abul Abbas as-Saffah founded the Abbasid Dynasty in 750 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Sindh was conquered for the Muslim world in 712 CE by:
textUr: سندھ کي 712 عيسوي ۾ اسلامي دنيا لاءِ ڪنهن فتح ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Muhammad bin Qasim conquered Sindh in 712 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Battle of Yarmouk, a major Muslim victory, was fought against which empire?
textUr: جنگِ يرموق ڪهڙي عظيم سلطنت خلاف لڙي وئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Battle of Yarmouk (636 CE) was fought against the Byzantine Empire.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Battle of Qadisiyyah, which broke Persian power, was fought against which empire?
textUr: جنگِ قادسيہ ڪهڙي سلطنت خلاف لڙي وئي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Battle of Qadisiyyah (636 CE) defeated the Sassanid Persian Empire.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Muslim commander led the conquest of Spain (Al-Andalus) in 711 CE?
textUr: اسپين (اندلس) کي 711 عيسوي ۾ فتح ڪندڙ مسلمان سپهه سالار ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Tariq bin Ziyad landed at Gibraltar and conquered Spain.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The University of Al-Qarawiyyin, widely recognized as one of the oldest continuously operating universities in the world, is located in:
textUr: دنيا جي قديم ترين يونيورسٽي 'القرويين' ڪهڙي ملڪ/شهر ۾ آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | University of Al-Qarawiyyin in Fes, Morocco was founded by Fatima al-Fihri in 859 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Baghdad, a major center of Islamic learning during the Abbasid era, was founded by which caliph?
textUr: عباسي دور ۾ تاريخي علمي مرڪز بغداد شهر جو بنياد ڪهڙي خليفي رکيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Caliph Al-Mansur founded Baghdad in 762 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which Abbasid caliph is especially remembered for establishing the 'Bait-ul-Hikmah' (House of Wisdom)?
textUr: بيت الحڪمة (House of Wisdom) جو قيام ڪهڙي عباسي خليفي جي دور ۾ ٿيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Khulafa-e-Rashideen | Caliph Al-Ma'mun expanded Bait-ul-Hikmah into a grand translation center.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Salahuddin Ayyubi is most famous for recapturing which city from the Crusaders in 1187 CE?
textUr: سلطان صلاح الدين ايوبي 1187ع ۾ صليبي فوجن کان ڪهڙو مقدس شهر آزاد ڪرايو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Salahuddin Ayyubi liberated Jerusalem after the Battle of Hattin.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Ottoman Empire, one of the longest-lasting Muslim empires, had its capital at:
textUr: عثماني خلافت (Ottoman Empire) جو دارالحکومت ڪهڙو شهر هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Istanbul (formerly Constantinople) was the capital of the Ottoman Empire.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Uqba bin Nafi is best known for founding which North African city?
textUr: عقبه بن نافع اتر آفريڪا ۾ ڪهڙي تاريخي شهر جو بنياد رکيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Uqba bin Nafi founded Kairouan in Tunisia in 670 CE.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The famous Muslim traveler who documented his journeys across the Islamic world in the 14th century was:
textUr: 14هين صديءَ جو مشهور مسلمان سياح جنهن عالمگير سفرنامو لکيو، سو ڪهڙو هو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Ibn Battuta traveled over 73,000 miles across Afro-Eurasia.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Al-Biruni, a renowned Muslim scholar, is especially noted for his extensive writings on:
textUr: علامه البيروني پنهنجي ڪتابن ۾ سڀ کان وڌيڪ تحقيقي نچوڙ ڪهڙي شئي جو پيش ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Al-Biruni wrote 'Kitab al-Hind' on Indian culture, astronomy, and science.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Ibn Sina (Avicenna) made his most lasting global contribution in the field of:
textUr: ابن سينا (Avicenna) دنيا ۾ سڀ کان وڌيڪ ڪهڙي ميدان ۾ نمايان حڪمت عملي ڏني؟
optionsUr: علم طب / ڊاڪٽري (Medicine - Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb)
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Ibn Sina wrote 'Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb' (The Canon of Medicine).

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Wudu' refers to:
textUr: 'وضوءَ' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Wudu is partial ritual ablution before prayer.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Ghusl' refers to:
textUr: 'غسل' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsUr: مڪمل پاڪائيءَ جو غسل (Full ritual bath)
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Ghusl is full ritual bath for purification.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Tayammum' is performed when:
textUr: 'تيمم' ڪڏهن ڪيو ويندو آهي؟
optionsEn: Water is unavailable or cannot be used
optionsUr: پاڻي ميسر نه هجي يا استعمال نه ڪري سگهجي
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Tayammum is dry ablution using clean dust/earth when water is absent.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many Fard (obligatory) acts are there in Wudu according to most jurists?
textUr: وضوءَ ۾ ڪل ڪيترا فرض آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Wudu has 4 Fard acts: washing face, washing arms to elbows, wiping head, washing feet.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Friday congregational prayer is called:
textUr: جمعيل مبارڪ واري باجماعت نماز ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Salat-ul-Jumu'ah is obligatory Friday congregational prayer.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The special night prayers offered during the month of Ramadan are called:
textUr: رمضان المبارڪ جي راتين ۾ ادا ڪئي ويندڙ نماز ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Tarawih is prayed during Ramadan nights.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The odd-numbered prayer offered after Isha, considered highly emphasized Sunnah, is called:
textUr: عشاءِ جي نماز کان پوءِ ادا ڪئي ويندڙ طاق نماز ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Witr prayer is performed after Isha.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The funeral prayer, offered standing without bowing or prostration, is called:
textUr: اهڙي نماز جنهن ۾ رکوع ۽ سجده ناهي هوندو، ڇا چئبي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Salat-ul-Janazah is performed standing without Ruku or Sujud.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: How many obligatory Takbeers are recited in the funeral prayer (Salat-ul-Janazah)?
textUr: نماز جنازه ۾ ڪل ڪيتريون تكبيرون چيون وينديون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Salat-ul-Janazah includes 4 Takbeers.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Circumambulating the Kaaba seven times is called:
textUr: خانه ڪعبه جو ست ڀيرا ڦيرو/طواف ڪرڻ ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Tawaf means circling the Kaaba 7 times.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Walking/running seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah during Hajj/Umrah is called:
textUr: صفا ۽ مروه جي جبلن وچ ۾ ست ڀيرا هلي پوري چڪر هڻڻ ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Sa'i is walking 7 times between Safa and Marwah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Standing at the plain of Arafat, a core ritual of Hajj, is called:
textUr: عرفات جي ميدان ۾ قيام ڪرڻ حج جو سڀ کان وڏو رکن آهي، ان کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Wuquf-e-Arafat on 9th Dhul-Hijjah is the main pillar of Hajj.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The charity given specifically at the end of Ramadan before Eid prayer is called:
textUr: رمضان المبارڪ جي پڄاڻي تي عييد نماز کان اڳ واپرائجندڙ صدقو ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Zakat-ul-Fitr (Fitrana) is paid before Eid-ul-Fitr prayer.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which of these invalidates the fast?
textUr: هيٺين مان ڪهڙي شئي سان روزو ٽٽي پوي ٿو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Intentionally eating or drinking invalidates the fast.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Eid prayer consists of how many Rakat, along with additional Takbeers?
textUr: عيد جي نماز ۾ ڪيتريون رڪعتون هونديون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Eid prayer consists of 2 Rakat with extra Takbeers.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Which of the following breaks Wudu?
textUr: هيٺين مان ڪهڙي شئي سان وضوءَ ٽٽي پوي ٿو؟
optionsUr: رياح خارج ٿيڻ / بهڪ حاصل ٿيڻ
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Passing intestinal gas invalidates Wudu.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Arabic word 'Zakat' literally means:
textUr: لفظ 'زڪواة' جو لغوي مفهوم آهي:
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Zakat literally means purification and growth.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Islam places great emphasis on kindness towards which two people, mentioned frequently alongside worship of Allah in the Quran?
textUr: قرآن مجيد ۾ الله تعاليٰ پنهنجي عبادت کان پوءِ ڪنهن سان احسان جو حڪم ڏنو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Filial piety to parents is repeatedly commanded in the Quran.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Islamic concept of treating others as one wishes to be treated is best reflected in the value of:
textUr: ٻين سان احسان ۽ نيڪيءَ وارو رويو اختيار ڪرڻ کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Ihsan means doing good and acting with excellence.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Sabr' in Islamic ethics refers to:
textUr: اسلامي اخلاقيات ۾ 'صبر' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Sabr is patience, self-restraint, and perseverance.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Shukr' in Islamic ethics refers to:
textUr: اسلامي اخلاقيات ۾ 'شڪر' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Shukr is expressing gratitude to Allah.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Islamic principle of maintaining trust and returning what is entrusted to you is called:
textUr: امانتن جي پاسداري ڪرڻ واري اخلاقي قدر کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Amanah means moral responsibility and trustworthiness.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Adl' in Islamic teaching refers to:
textUr: اسلامي تعليمات ۾ 'عدل' مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Adl means equity, justice, and fairness.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Sincerity of intention purely for the sake of Allah is called:
textUr: صرف ۽ صرف الله جي رضا لاءِ نيت رکڻ کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Ikhlas is purity of intention for Allah alone.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Showing off good deeds to gain praise from people, which Islam strongly warns against, is called:
textUr: ماڻهن جي واه واه حاصل ڪرڻ لاءِ نيڪي ڏيکارڻ کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: The Holy Quran | Riya (showing off) is minor shirk that ruins good deeds.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: 'Ihsan' in Islamic teaching is often described as:
textUr: احسان جي حقيقت جنهن حديث ۾ آئي آهي ان مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
optionsEn: Worshipping Allah as though you see Him
optionsUr: الله جي ائين عبادت ڪرڻ ڄڻ ته تون کيس ڏسي رهيو آهين
explanationEn: Topic: Pillars of Islam | Hadith Jibreel: Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: Islam's teaching regarding neighbors emphasizes:
textUr: اسلام ۾ پاڙيسريءَ سان سلوڪ جو حڪم ڇا آهي؟
optionsEn: Being kind and caring toward them regardless of faith
optionsUr: پاڙيسري سان ڀلائي ۽ خيال رکڻ (Being kind to neighbors)
explanationEn: Topic: Hadith & Sunnah | Islam strictly mandates kindness to all neighbors.

subject: Islamic Studies
textEn: The Prophet (ﷺ) said the best among people are those who:
textUr: حضور سڳوري (صہ) فرمايو ته ماڻهن مان سڀ کان بهترين سو آهي جنهن سان:
optionsUr: ٻين ماڻهن کي سڀ کان وڌيڪ نفعو/فائدو پهچائي
explanationEn: Topic: Islamic History | Hadith: 'The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.'
